name: Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE)
description: Calculates ground state energy of molecular Hamiltonians (H2, LiH, H2O) using hybrid quantum-classical optimization.
prompt: Formulate a VQE algorithm to calculate H2 molecule ground state energy with UCCSD ansatz.
definition: Variational method to find the minimum eigenvalue of a Hamiltonian using a parameterized ansatz.
use_case: Molecular ground state energy calculations and quantum chemistry simulations.
practical_use: Developing new chemical catalysts and molecular research for drug discovery.

name: Adapt-VQE
description: Adaptive derivative-assembled pseudo-trotterized VQE for compact chemical ansatz construction.
prompt: Formulate an Adapt-VQE circuit for LiH ground state energy estimation with adaptive operator pool.
definition: VQE variant that dynamically grows the ansatz operator pool step-by-step based on energy gradients.
use_case: Compact chemical ansatz representation with minimal gate depth.
practical_use: High-precision simulation of strongly correlated electronic systems like battery materials.

name: Subspace-Search VQE (SS-VQE)
description: Determines excited energy states of molecular systems using orthogonal subspace state preparation.
prompt: Build an SS-VQE algorithm to compute low-lying excited states of a 4-qubit molecular Hamiltonian.
definition: Subspace search VQE designed to compute excited state energies of a Hamiltonian.
use_case: Molecular excited state calculations and spectral properties.
practical_use: Simulating photo-chemical reactions and solar cell material optimization.

name: Quantum Approximate Optimization (QAOA)
description: Solves combinatorial optimization and graph partitioning problems using alternating cost and mixer Hamiltonians.
prompt: Formulate a 4-node QAOA Max-Cut algorithm with 2 p-layers and SPSA classical optimizer.
definition: Quantum algorithm designed to solve combinatorial optimization problems using alternating operators.
use_case: Max-Cut, graph partitioning, and combinatorial optimization.
practical_use: Logistics route planning, traffic flow management, and financial portfolio optimization.

name: Warm-Start QAOA
description: Initializes QAOA quantum state from continuous relaxation of semidefinite programming (SDP) solutions.
prompt: Construct a Warm-Start QAOA model for Graph Coloring initialized from continuous SDP solution.
definition: QAOA initialized with classical optimization solutions to speed up quantum convergence.
use_case: Accelerated combinatorial optimization on noisy devices.
practical_use: Power grid distribution networks optimization and supply chain layout scheduling.

name: HHL Linear Systems Solver
description: Solves linear systems of equations Ax = b with exponential speedup over classical solvers.
prompt: Build an HHL quantum circuit to solve 2x2 linear equation system Ax = b.
definition: Quantum algorithm to solve linear systems of equations (Ax = b) with exponential speedup.
use_case: Solving large-scale systems of linear differential equations.
practical_use: Fluid dynamics simulation in aerospace design and electromagnetic modeling.

name: Variational Quantum Linear Solver (VQLS)
description: NISQ-friendly variational algorithm for solving large linear systems using shallow quantum circuits.
prompt: Formulate a VQLS algorithm to solve a 4-qubit linear system with Hadamard test cost evaluation.
definition: Variational algorithm to solve linear equations on NISQ-era quantum hardware.
use_case: NISQ-friendly linear system equation solvers.
practical_use: Stress analysis in structural engineering and thermal distribution modeling.

name: Shor's Factoring Algorithm
description: Performs prime factorization of integers in polynomial time using quantum period finding.
prompt: Explain and construct Shor's factoring algorithm for integer N = 15.
definition: Quantum algorithm to find the prime factors of an integer in polynomial time.
use_case: Integer factorization and discrete logarithms.
practical_use: Cryptographic security analysis and transitioning to post-quantum cryptography (PQC).

name: Simon's Algorithm
description: Demonstrates exponential quantum speedup for finding hidden bitstrings in periodic functions.
prompt: Construct Simon's algorithm circuit for finding a 3-bit hidden period string s = 110.
definition: Oracle-based algorithm proving exponential speedup for finding periodicity in black-box functions.
use_case: Determining periodicity and cryptographic structure analysis.
practical_use: Analyzing security bounds of symmetric key cryptographic primitives like block ciphers.

name: Deutsch-Jozsa Algorithm
description: Determines whether a boolean function is constant or balanced in a single quantum evaluation.
prompt: Build a Deutsch-Jozsa circuit for a 3-qubit balanced oracle.
definition: First quantum algorithm demonstrating deterministic exponential speedup over classical algorithms.
use_case: Evaluating if a black-box function is constant or balanced.
practical_use: Binary decision tree evaluation and testing logic gate function parity.

name: Bernstein-Vazirani Algorithm
description: Finds a hidden linear function bitstring in a single query using parallel Hadamard interference.
prompt: Construct a Bernstein-Vazirani circuit to reveal hidden binary string s = 1011.
definition: Quantum algorithm to find a hidden bitstring in a black-box function in a single query.
use_case: Hidden parameter extraction and function oracle inversion.
practical_use: Database search key extraction and optimal query design in network routing.

name: Grover Search Algorithm
description: Provides quadratic speedup for searching unstructured databases using phase inversion and amplitude amplification.
prompt: Construct a 4-qubit Grover Search circuit to locate target state |1011>.
definition: Quantum database search algorithm providing quadratic speedup for unstructured databases.
use_case: Unstructured database searching and solving NP-complete problems.
practical_use: Cracking symmetric key ciphers (e.g., AES keys) and optimizing constraint satisfaction problems.

name: Quantum Counting Algorithm
description: Combines Grover search and Quantum Phase Estimation to count target solutions in an unstructured search space.
prompt: Formulate a Quantum Counting circuit with 3 counting qubits and Grover operator.
definition: Quantum algorithm estimating the number of solutions to a search problem by combining Grover and QPE.
use_case: Solution count estimation in unstructured search spaces.
practical_use: Estimating feasibility in combinatorial scheduling and cryptographic key search space analysis.

name: Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE)
description: Estimates the phase/eigenvalue of a unitary operator corresponding to an eigenvector.
prompt: Construct a Quantum Phase Estimation circuit for T-gate eigenvalue extraction using 3 counting qubits.
definition: Quantum algorithm to estimate the phase of an eigenvalue of a unitary operator.
use_case: Eigenvalue estimation, Shor's algorithm, and Hamiltonian simulation.
practical_use: Precision molecular energy level estimation and quantum phase calibration.

name: Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT)
description: Quantum analogue of discrete Fourier transform converting computational basis to phase basis.
prompt: Build a 4-qubit Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) circuit with controlled phase rotations.
definition: Quantum analogue of the discrete Fourier transform performing exponential speedup.
use_case: Frequency analysis, phase estimation, and quantum arithmetic.
practical_use: Signal processing, quantum cryptography, and spectral analysis of quantum systems.

name: Quantum Neural Network (QNN)
description: Parameterized quantum circuit trained as a neural network model for classification tasks.
prompt: Build a 4-qubit Quantum Neural Network classifier with two-local feature map and variational layers.
definition: Neural network architecture built using parameterized quantum circuits.
use_case: Quantum machine learning, classification, and pattern recognition.
practical_use: Predictive modeling in medical imaging diagnostics and financial anomaly detection.

name: Quantum Support Vector Machine (QSVM)
description: Maps data into high-dimensional Hilbert feature space for quantum kernel estimation.
prompt: Formulate a Quantum Support Vector Machine classifier with ZZFeatureMap for 2D data separation.
definition: Quantum support vector machine using quantum kernels to classify non-linear data.
use_case: Supervised machine learning and high-dimensional classification.
practical_use: Credit risk scoring and classification of complex genomic datasets.

name: Quantum Autoencoder
description: Compresses high-dimensional quantum states into smaller latent qubit registers.
prompt: Design a Quantum Autoencoder to compress 4-qubit quantum states into 2 latent qubits.
definition: Quantum circuit trained to compress quantum states into a lower-dimensional latent space.
use_case: Quantum data compression and noise reduction.
practical_use: Reducing quantum communication overhead and state purification on noisy channels.

name: Variational Quantum Regressor
description: Fits continuous function targets using parameterized quantum circuit expectation values.
prompt: Formulate a 2-qubit Variational Quantum Regressor for sine wave function approximation.
definition: Variational algorithm trained to predict continuous output values from input features.
use_case: Quantum regression analysis and curve fitting.
practical_use: Macroeconomic forecasting and predicting chemical bond dynamics.

name: Trotterized Quantum Dynamics
description: Simulates time evolution of multi-body quantum systems using Suzuki-Trotter product formulas.
prompt: Construct a 4-qubit Trotterized time-evolution circuit for 1D transverse field Ising model.
definition: Hamiltonian simulation using Trotter-Suzuki product formulas to discretize time evolution.
use_case: Time-dependent quantum state evolution simulation.
practical_use: Modeling superconductor dynamics and studying spin glass physics.

name: Quantum Signal Processing (QSP)
description: Applies arbitrary polynomial transformations to block-encoded matrix operators.
prompt: Formulate a Quantum Signal Processing sequence for polynomial matrix function evaluation.
definition: Method to implement polynomial transformations of eigenvalues of a block-encoded matrix.
use_case: Optimal Hamiltonian simulation and matrix function evaluation.
practical_use: High-precision physical system simulation and implementing general matrix math on quantum chips.

name: Quantum Singular Value Transformation (QSVT)
description: Unifies quantum algorithms by transforming singular values of block-encoded operators.
prompt: Build a Quantum Singular Value Transformation blueprint for matrix inversion.
definition: Quantum Singular Value Transformation unifying quantum algorithms into a single framework.
use_case: Unified linear algebra, matrix inversion, and search algorithms.
practical_use: General-purpose quantum machine learning and advanced system model solvers.

name: Discrete-Time Quantum Walk
description: Quantum random walk on graph networks achieving quadratic speedup over classical random walks.
prompt: Formulate a Discrete-Time Quantum Walk on a hypercube graph using coin and shift operators.
definition: Quantum analogue of classical random walks displaying faster propagation speeds.
use_case: Graph traversal and database search algorithms.
practical_use: Analyzing topological network connections and optimization of route distributions.

name: Quantum Generative Adversarial Network (qGAN)
description: Trains quantum generator and classical discriminator to learn complex probability distributions.
prompt: Construct a 4-qubit Quantum GAN to learn a 1D Gaussian probability distribution.
definition: Quantum Generative Adversarial Network generating quantum states mirroring real data distributions.
use_case: Generative machine learning and synthetic quantum state preparation.
practical_use: Simulating synthetic financial market scenarios and high-dimensional probability generation.
